colossians.4.p1.b1.text: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

colossians.4.p1.b2.text: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

colossians.4.p1.b3.text: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, …

colossians.4.p1.b4.text: … so that you may know how to answer everyone.

colossians.4.p2.b1.text: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.

colossians.4.p2.b2.text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, … and that he may encourage your hearts.

colossians.4.p2.b3.text: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you.

colossians.4.p2.b4.text: They will tell you about everything here.

colossians.4.p3.b1.text: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, …

colossians.4.p3.b2.text: … as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas.

colossians.4.p3.b3.text: You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.

colossians.4.p3.b4.text: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. … and they have been a comfort to me.

colossians.4.p4.b1.text: Epaphras, who is one of you … sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, …

colossians.4.p4.b2.text: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

colossians.4.p4.b3.text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.

colossians.4.p4.b4.text: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.

colossians.4.p5.b1.text: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, …

colossians.4.p5.b2.text: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”

colossians.4.p5.b3.text: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains.
